claudeArgs: Build the cinema seat-booking web application described in spec/README.md, as the Angular application already set up in this Nx workspace (Nx project `cinescope` in apps/cinescope); its stack is described in spec/stack.md. The work is split into tickets in spec/tickets/; implement them in order. spec/README.md is the complete specification: do not ask any questions, and where it is silent choose the simplest option that satisfies it. Finish only when every ticket is done and `pnpm nx build cinescope` succeeds.
